title: C¹ compactly supported radial potential with gradient g(|y|²)·y
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let r > 0, and let g : ℝ → ℝ be continuous with g(t) = 0 for every t ≥ r². Then there is Ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝ (ℝⁿ = Euclid n) such that (a) Ψ is C¹ on ℝⁿ, (b) Ψ has compact support, (c) tsupport Ψ ⊆ closedBall(0, r), and (d) DΨ(y)v = g(|y|²)·⟨y, v⟩ for all y, v ∈ ℝⁿ, where DΨ(y) = fderiv ℝ Ψ y and ⟨·,·⟩ is the Euclidean inner product.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), 0 < r → Continuous g → (∀ t : ℝ, r ^ 2 ≤ t → g t = 0) → ∃ Ψ : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 Ψ ∧ HasCompactSupport Ψ ∧ tsupport Ψ ⊆ closedBall 0 r ∧ ∀ y v : Euclid n, fderiv ℝ Ψ y v = g (‖y‖ ^ 2) * inner ℝ y v
